Pawprint support

How can we help?

For account help, privacy questions, export requests, deletion requests, or safety reports, email hello.pawprint.app@gmail.com. Send your message from the email address used for Pawprint when possible. Never send your password or sign-in code.

Export or delete your account

  1. Sign in to Pawprint.
  2. Open Profile.
  3. Choose Download my data to get a copy, or Delete account to remove your account.

Deletion removes your Journal, photos, and exact capture points within 30 days. Public pins expire after 24 hours.

Privacy and data rights

For access, correction, objection, erasure, portability, or consent-withdrawal requests, email hello.pawprint.app@gmail.com. We aim to respond within 15 days. You may also contact the National Privacy Commission.

Our privacy/DPO contact is John Carlo M. Manalo, Muntinlupa City, Philippines.

Report a concern

Use Report in the app or email us with a link or screenshot if you see an unsafe spot, harmful content, privacy concern, or a cat that needs help. Care Flags are community observations, not veterinary diagnoses.

For emergencies, contact a veterinarian, local animal-welfare group, or barangay first.
